cases.claim:
Handle HTTP 403 in blog sync without failing the scheduled `sync` job

cases.task: P15-87: Temporarily skip the widgets extension in the archive
cases.claim:
P15-87: Temporarily skip the widgets extension in the archive
TestFlight build 69 failed at the archive step. The `.widgets` App ID has no provisioning profile with the App Groups capability, so signing rejects the widgets entitlements. This PR takes the widgets extension out of the archive so the other work can ship. The owner still has to add the capability in the Apple developer portal. Refs DanAakesen/jarvis#1589

- **`apps/ios/project.yml`**
  - Removes the `JarvisWidgets` embed from the Jarvis app dependencies and adds a comment pointing to #1589.

cases.task: Allow `kodata` symlinks within the repository root
cases.claim:
Allow `kodata` symlinks within the repository root
The `kodata` symlink hardening was too narrow: it rejected symlinks to files that are part of the same repository but live outside the package’s `kodata/` directory, which breaks common layouts like shared `LICENSE` and repo-level config. This change keeps the exfiltration guard, but moves the trust boundary to the repository root when that boundary is knowable.

- **Problem**
  - `kodata/` symlinks were only allowed to resolve within `kodata/` itself.
  - That blocked legitimate in-repo targets
